description: Supplements in Aviado's evidence graph that move a biomarker (e.g. 'LDL cholesterol', 'HbA1c'). Lists only registry-classified supplements: entities Aviado's identity vocabulary types as supplement, class or combination and marks recommendable; prescription drugs, research compounds, foods and unknown ids are excluded (use get_interventions_for_biomarker for all of them). Each hit has direction (up/down/bidirectional), prior_weight (evidence confidence 0-1, not effect size), graph_status (proven/suspected: internal eligibility labels, not clinical verification), has_verified_support / mixed_evidence, and dose (mean study dose {value, unit}: evidence context, not a dosing recommendation; see coverage.dose_note). Rows carry up to 3 PubMed IDs (pmids; URL template in coverage) with n_studies / rct_count; optional direction (up/down) filters. Null fields and default typing (coverage.row_defaults) are omitted per row. Results are partial and non-exhaustive; pathway_tags are raw graph metadata, not validated mechanisms. The biomarker may be a name, an abbreviation, an Aviado id or a LOINC code (e.g. '4548-4'). Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.

biomarker.description: Biomarker name, abbreviation, or LOINC code

direction.description: Only rows whose strongest edge moves the biomarker this way ('down' lowers it, 'up' raises it); bidirectional rows match neither

name: get_supplements_for_biomarker
title: Supplements for a biomarker
